narr: Heavy monsoon rains caused flash flooding in a couple of areas.
ev: Public reported, via Facebook, a video of flooded washes and a flooded road. Time and specific location were estimated.
A stream gauge on Tonto Creek (TNRA3) measured a 3.02 ft rise in 45 minutes. Can infer flash flooding further upstream near the Rye Creek and Tonto Creek confluence.
